# SOLON

> SOLON (SOLON SRL) is the digital agency for Romanian lawyers and LegalTech. Site: https://solon.agency/

SOLON is a digital agency for lawyers in Romania. It provides branding, websites, SEO, and digitalization for legal practices. The legal entity is SOLON SRL (tax ID 49995463).

This site is not Multisoft SOLON, the restaurant and hotel management software.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://solon.agency/): Digital agency for Romanian lawyers and LegalTech
- [Case studies](https://solon.agency/studii-de-caz/): Client work for law firms and lawyers
- [Free consultation](https://solon.agency/programare-consultanta-gratuita/): Book a consultation
- [Blog](https://solon.agency/blog/): Guides on digitalization and LegalTech for lawyers
- [Services](https://solon.agency/#servicii): Branding, development, and marketing on the homepage
